rationale: Stopping with a clarification is the correct outcome for unquantified FASTQ inputs, and the planner correctly identified the data state (6 paired-end samples, 3 vs 3, no counts) and offered the two valid routes (a count matrix or an index plus an aligner/pseudoaligner). It did not, however, name a specific quantifier (Salmon, kallisto, STAR+featureCounts) or ask which reference build and annotation version apply, which the reference expects. No downstream plan was stated at all, so QC, filtering, normalization, formula/contrast, and BH/shrinkage receive minimal credit; enrichment omission is trivially correct here. The report criterion gets partial credit only for the accurate design description embedded in the question.
